evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` RPC methods in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp`.
rationale: Adds RPC endpoints to manage prune locks so external applications and offline wallets can prevent necessary block files from being deleted on pruned nodes. Downstream tools like indexers and external wallets specifically benefit, eliminating the need to resync an entire node when an application falls behind.
